purpose: Prospectively test eight remaining quantitative response-law families using fresh commit-seeded synthetic worlds. This is K5-style held-regime evidence, not real-workload or independent-authorship closure.

B_ROUTING.question: fixed union routing vs input-dependent routing
B_ROUTING.fixed_prediction: dynamic wins iff saved inactive-edge work exceeds routing/communication overhead; fixed wins otherwise
B_ROUTING.red: winner disagrees with frozen inequality after exact measured costs

B_SPECIALIZATION.question: shared estimator vs per-mode specialization with routing
B_SPECIALIZATION.fixed_prediction: without routing cost, specialization wins when tau^2 > sigma^2/N*(1-1/m); actual winner must include measured router error/cost
B_SPECIALIZATION.red: protected winner/crossover lies outside preregistered finite-sample uncertainty band

B_RESIDUAL.question: shared core only vs shared core+sparse residual vs explicit full state
B_RESIDUAL.fixed_prediction: core-only wins at zero residual; core+residual wins while exception code/update burden is below full-state burden; full state wins once sparse-residual advantage disappears
B_RESIDUAL.red: measured admissible frontier contradicts the burden inequality

B_COMPILE_SEARCH.question: per-query search vs precompiled reusable answer state
B_COMPILE_SEARCH.fixed_prediction: compile wins once build_cost < reuse*(search_serve-compiled_serve); search wins below crossover
B_COMPILE_SEARCH.red: winner disagrees with exact amortization inequality

C_FEATURE_LEARNING.question: fixed feature/readout vs trainable nonlinear features
C_FEATURE_LEARNING.fixed_prediction: if protected target residual outside fixed tangent/feature span exceeds tolerance, fixed-feature realization cannot pass; trainable-feature realization may pass only if development reaches it within budget
C_FEATURE_LEARNING.red: fixed-feature passes despite certified residual lower bound, or predicted reachable trainable regime systematically fails under frozen budget

D_GENERATIVE.question: prefix-conditional state vs component/latent state on equal-likelihood finite distributions
D_GENERATIVE.fixed_prediction: semantic likelihood cannot choose the family; component state wins when component-table burden < distinct-prefix tree burden plus sequential serving, prefix state wins when prefix reuse reverses the lifecycle inequality
D_GENERATIVE.red: lifecycle winner disagrees with frozen exact representation/serve accounting

E_CONTROL.question: direct learned policy vs reusable learned dynamics+planning
E_CONTROL.fixed_prediction: model route wins when reuse benefit exceeds planning cost plus 2*model-value-error penalty; direct policy wins below crossover
E_CONTROL.red: held winner contradicts the preregistered reuse/error bound at matched return tolerance

F_CONTINUAL.question: full rewrite vs replay vs isolated expansion
F_CONTINUAL.fixed_prediction: strict retention plus low overlap favors isolated expansion; high reusable overlap can favor shared update/replay once its information/update burden is lower
F_CONTINUAL.red: frontier morphology reverses outside the registered overlap/retention burden law

quality_rule: Compare lifecycle burden only among realizations satisfying the lane-specific semantic/quality threshold. An inadmissible low-cost realization cannot win.
measurement_rule: Raw event counts are primary. Wall-clock/RSS are secondary environment-specific measurements. Every failed seed is retained.
public_seed_rule: Use one future drand quicknet beacon selected by a successor beacon contract committed after the runner is frozen; derive each task seed from beacon randomness + lane + grid value + replicate index.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic held-regime K5-style phase evidence. Does not close real transfer, independent authorship, modern large-model scaling or hardware/nonclassical frontiers.
